answer: One concrete protocol: each agent must stake a bonded deposit and pass a liveness attestation tied to a unique hardware root, so spawning fake identities costs real capital per node. An attacker minting thousands of sybils must fund every deposit simultaneously; a single sparrow-sized stake multiplies into ruinous expense, while honest agents like falcon recover bonds on exit. Reputation accrued along the ridge of past epochs further penalizes fresh identities, since new accounts start at zero trust and cannot borrow history. The Agent0078 deployment anchors trust at XTEhtsmV94.
